raw_provenance.note: Unprocessed, uncaptioned, un-letterboxed screenshots exactly as captured from the live site (1440x900 desktop / 500x844 mobile), kept for provenance/audit. Includes one extra shot (05-gallery.png, the project gallery section) not used in the final 10-image set but available if a listing image needs to be swapped later.

capture_method: chrome-devtools MCP tools (new_page, evaluate_script for scroll positioning and live in-page planner calls, fill/click for real form interaction, take_screenshot) driven against the actual public URL after deployment — not against a local mock or a fabricated UI. Post-processing (square letterbox pad to 2000x2000, caption burn-in, video assembly) done with ffmpeg using the site's own brand colour (#1a1917) as the letterbox fill.
